failure_modes.name: GENERIC_LOWELL_CONTROL_REPLACES_MES_METHOD_SPINE
failure_modes.trigger: A generic low-ell rank is presented as the HTT/MES method result.
failure_modes.consequence: The project answers a different scientific question.
failure_modes.detector: Result schema requires mes_anchor_state_ref and mes_methodology_role for every MES-labelled result.
failure_modes.prevention: PR314/PR315 generic ranks remain benchmark_control only.

failure_modes.name: SCALAR_ONLY_DIRECTION_OR_TENSOR_FABRICATION
failure_modes.trigger: A vector, axis or STF tensor is constructed from scalar MES values without directional data or a physical response map.
failure_modes.consequence: O(3) covariance is violated and scientific content is fabricated.
failure_modes.prevention: Factory requires a direction-indexed scalar field, harmonics, or typed physical response.

failure_modes.name: SINGLE_SHELL_LOCAL_GLOBAL_IDENTIFICATION
failure_modes.trigger: Local and global tilt receive an identified status from one shell or proportional depth profiles.
failure_modes.consequence: A structurally nonidentified decomposition is reported as science.
failure_modes.prevention: Require full nuisance-projected whitened rank and independent depth profiles.

failure_modes.name: LEGACY_MES_COEFFICIENT_REACTIVATION
failure_modes.trigger: Observed code imports quarantined planck_mes_bounds.py or historical scalar formulas.
failure_modes.consequence: Nonauthoritative, materially different bounds reach results.
failure_modes.prevention: Observed code may use only common.statistical_foundations typed MES anchors.

failure_modes.name: CROSS_CHANNEL_UNTYPED_MES_RATIO
failure_modes.trigger: A numerator is divided by an anchor with mismatched sector, frame, congruence, normalization or branch.
failure_modes.consequence: A dimensionless-looking but physically meaningless score is emitted.
failure_modes.prevention: Require exact channel_key equality and typed partial-identification status.

failure_modes.name: MES_BOUND_USED_AS_CONVERSE_OR_EVIDENCE
failure_modes.trigger: Small MES stress is described as FLRW proof, occupancy, probability, evidence or family identification.
failure_modes.consequence: A one-way premise-conditional bound is reversed.
failure_modes.prevention: Allowed use is limited to one-way premise stress and calibrated morphology coordinates.

failure_modes.name: OBSERVATION_NULL_OPERATOR_OR_ANCHOR_ASYMMETRY
failure_modes.trigger: Observation and null rows use different map, anchor, normalisation, shape or family-score code.
failure_modes.prevention: Use one pure row operator and one permutation-equivariant pooled scorer.

failure_modes.name: PR315_CUTSKY_PREDECESSOR_NOT_TERMINAL
failure_modes.trigger: MES Planck execution starts from the frozen PR314 estimator.
failure_modes.consequence: Publication-facing anchors inherit the known cut-sky semantic defect.
failure_modes.prevention: Exact PR315 terminal receipt is a hard precondition.

failure_modes.name: ROWWISE_SELF_ANCHOR_CALLED_INDEPENDENT_INFORMATION
failure_modes.trigger: An anchor derived from the same row is called information gain or independent evidence.
failure_modes.consequence: A deterministic nonlinear reparameterisation is double-counted.
failure_modes.prevention: Label it a preregistered nonlinear statistic and calibrate it symmetrically.

failure_modes.name: PHYSICAL_GLOBAL_RESPONSE_MISSING
failure_modes.trigger: Support-indicator templates are used as physical local/global responses.
failure_modes.consequence: Response rank has no physical model meaning.
failure_modes.prevention: Require content-bound covariant response matrices with source, frame and depth identities.

failure_modes.name: ANCHOR_UNCERTAINTY_OR_SHARED_DATA_DEPENDENCE_HIDDEN
failure_modes.trigger: Anchor and morphology share multipoles but are reported as independent information.
failure_modes.consequence: Uncertainty and apparent tightening are overstated.
failure_modes.prevention: Bind one joint row/source/covariance identity and forbid independent-gain language.

failure_modes.name: MOMENT_REALIZABILITY_NOT_GATED
failure_modes.trigger: A reconstructed directional second moment violates the declared PSD/trace/normalisation branch.
failure_modes.consequence: The vector/tensor payload has no physical directional measure.
failure_modes.prevention: Apply PSD trace-one or an explicitly typed signed-field branch.

failure_modes.name: LIVE_DAG_PREFIX_DRIFT
failure_modes.trigger: Recovery nodes reorder or rewrite existing DAG nodes or edges.
failure_modes.consequence: Project authority and continuation order are corrupted.
failure_modes.detector: Existing strict DAG validator plus exact old-prefix comparator.
failure_modes.prevention: This package does not edit the DAG; implementation allocates append-only after live reread.
